Reactor School × APPA · Summer 2027

Singapore Future Tech & Business Summer Programme

July – August 2027 · 5 days, 4 nights · ages 15 to 18

Five days inside Singapore’s robotics labs, startups and universities. Build a robot, turn plastic waste into a product, meet NUS faculty and student investors, then present as a team on the final morning.

Register interestSee the programme
For senior high school students aged 15 to 18

Build Your Future in Singapore 🚀

Over five days, your child goes inside Singapore’s robotics labs, universities and startups. They build things with their own hands, talk with professors, founders and investors, and present their ideas in English. Here is what they bring home.

🤖

Hands-on Tech Skills

Students see AI, robotics and digital twins run a real factory, then build a working robot and turn plastic waste into a product. They learn to prototype with whatever tools are at hand, and keep what they make.

🎓

Clearer University Pathways

Visits to NUS and SMU in one week show what studying engineering, design and business really involves. Professors, undergraduates and student investors answer questions directly, so students see which path suits them.

🎤

Confidence and a Stronger Portfolio

Every session includes time to ask questions in English, and the week ends with a team presentation. Students leave with their builds, a presentation to talk about and a Reactor School certificate for school and university applications.

What’s in the programme

Visits and workshops

Sustainability

Plastify workshop

Shred and mould plastic waste into a product to take home.

Hands-on

Stick’Em Robotics

Meet the 2025 Hult Prize winners and build a working robot from chopsticks and connectors.

AI & Robotics

Hyundai Motor Group Innovation Center Singapore

Inside Hyundai’s global innovation hub, where AI, robotics and digital twins run an electric vehicle production line. Includes a VR factory tour, the vertical smart farm and the rooftop Skytrack.

AI & Robotics

NUS College of Design and Engineering

Robotics and technology lab demos with NUS professors and undergraduates.

Culture

Singapore Maritime Gallery

How a trading post became one of the world’s busiest ports, with a ship simulator.

Present

Closing presentation and certificate ceremony

Each team presents what it learned during the week, then receives a Reactor School blockchain-enabled digital certificate for school and university applications.

Business

SMU and Protégé Ventures

Southeast Asia’s first student-led VC fund on how they pick startups to back.

Day by day

The 5-Day Agenda

Five packed days across AI and robotics, business and ventures, and sustainability and impact. Students visit a global car maker’s innovation centre, two universities and three startups, and finish by presenting what they learned.

‼️ The agenda is indicative and subject to change based on host availability.

Frequently asked questions

Who is this programme for?

Senior high school students aged 15 to 18 from Thai international schools. No coding or business experience is needed.

When is it?

July or August 2027. Exact dates are being set around the Thai international school summer break and will be announced by APPA.

Who looks after my child?

APPA staff travel with the group and provide chaperoning and pastoral care. Reactor School facilitators run every session in Singapore.

What language is it in?

English. Every session includes time for students to ask questions.

Are flights and visas included?

No. Flights, visas, travel insurance and personal expenses are not included. APPA can advise on these.
